headlines.title: Pennsylvania teen dies from measles complications, health officials report
headlines.description: An 18-year-old with measles died from a rare and severe neurological condition that causes inflammation in the brain.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania woman’s measles death shows risks to people with health problems
headlines.description: The unvaccinated 40-year-old, who died Saturday, had asthma and lung disease, the county coroner’s office said. A test showed the woman tested positive for measles.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania reports fourth death linked to measles
headlines.description: Pennsylvania confirmed that a fourth person had died from measles, the first deaths from the virus in 35 years. All of the patients who died were not vaccinated.

headlines.title: Cooling towers at Yankee Stadium test positive for Legionnaires' in new cluster
headlines.description: The New York City Health Department has ordered 10 cooling towers in the South Bronx, including one at Yankee Stadium, to be cleaned and disinfected after preliminary testing found the presence of Legionella bacteria as officials investigate a cluster. NBC News medical contributor Natalie Azar discusses how the test was conducted the possible threat level to attendees.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania records third measles-related death
headlines.description: A 40-year-old Pennsylvania woman who died with what appears to be measles-related complications also had ongoing lung problems, including asthma and COPD, according to the coroner’s office who handled the case. It would be the third measles-related death in Pennsylvania amid a surging outbreak of the virus. 693 cases had been confirmed so far this year in the state, with 99 in the last week alone. NBC News' Erika Edwards reports.

headlines.title: CDC finds that nearly 3 in 4 U.S. adults report struggling with fatigue
headlines.description: A new CDC report reveals that fatigue is a widespread concern among U.S. adults, with nearly three-quarters reporting feeling very tired or exhausted on multiple days over the past three months. Board-certified sleep specialist Dr. Carol Ash explains the causes of fatigue and shares simple tips to improve sleep and boost energy.

headlines.title: Why are Americans so tired so often? New CDC report highlights who’s feeling it most
headlines.description: About 71% of of adults in the U.S. say they experience fatigue, a new report from the CDC found. Women and younger adults are feeling it most often.
